# Changelog

All notable changes to this plugin will be documented here.

## 1.0.0 — initial release

- Added the `bill` MCP server pointing at `https://gateway.prod.bill.com/ai-mcp-server/v1`.
- Auth uses OAuth with a Client ID Metadata Document against `auth.bill.com` — no API key or client ID to configure.
- Logo: BILL's official mark, from `bill.com`.
